component.name: Thandor Map Editor
component.summary: Edit Thandor maps and investigate AI in the Simulation Lab

description.p: Thandor Map Editor is a Vulkan-based editor for stock Thandor maps and custom map projects. Browse game assets, edit terrain and placed objects, generate landscapes and rivers, and configure map lighting and players.

The Simulation Lab runs independent simulations on a map and compares original KI.DAT parameter settings. Inspect units, buildings, visibility and per-run results in the editor. Original game data is required and is not included in the AppImage.
